subject: Cloaker
picture: A cloaker flies through a dungeon hall. Copy this body: a ribbed manta-ray cloak. Wide triangular wings with a few large rib lines. The head is the front edge of the cloak, two eyes and an open mouth on that leading edge. One long thin tail behind. No bat ears, no hanging animal claws, no person inside. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
